title: Spikers' Turf: Player of the Week Villados steers Criss Cross to unbeaten start
summary: Criss Cross has surged to a perfect start in the 2026 Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference, thanks in large part to setter Adrian Villados' superb playmaking.
